faqs.question: What is Goat Funded Trader?
faqs.answer: Goat Funded Trader (GFT) is a proprietary trading firm founded in 2022 and registered through Wishes Tower International Limited in Hong Kong (with an additional Goat Funded LTD entity in Saint Lucia). It offers 1-Step, 2-Step, 3-Step and Instant Funding evaluations on accounts from $5,000 to $400,000, with a fully refundable challenge fee on the first funded payout.

seo.title: What is Goat Funded Trader? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Goat Funded Trader is a Hong Kong-registered prop firm founded in 2022, offering 1-Step to 3-Step and Instant Funding accounts.

faqs.question: What is the Goat Funded Trader profit split?
faqs.answer: The default funded split is 80% to the trader and 20% to the firm. Traders can pay for a 100% split add-on at checkout, or climb the 4-level scaling plan to reach up to a 95% split organically at the top GOAT tier, one of the highest ceilings in the industry.

seo.title: Goat Funded Trader Profit Split: 80% to 100% | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Goat Funded Trader starts at an 80% split, with a paid 100% add-on or scaling progression up to a 95% organic split.

faqs.question: How often can I withdraw from Goat Funded Trader?
faqs.answer: Standard funded accounts pay out bi-weekly (every 2 weeks). Goat Funded Trader publicly commits to a 2-business-day processing window and pays traders a $500 bonus if a payout is late. Reaching Scaling Level 2 (4 months funded, 6 payouts) unlocks weekly payouts instead.

seo.title: Goat Funded Trader Payout Cycle | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Goat Funded Trader pays bi-weekly by default, processes payouts within 2 business days, and unlocks weekly cycles at Level 2.

faqs.question: Does Goat Funded Trader charge withdrawal fees or refund the challenge fee?
faqs.answer: Goat Funded Trader does not add its own commission on bank, Skrill or crypto payouts; only third-party network or bank charges may apply. The evaluation fee is fully refundable and is credited back automatically with your first successful funded payout, effectively making a passed challenge free.

seo.title: Goat Funded Trader Fees and Challenge Refund | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Goat Funded Trader charges no internal payout commission and fully refunds the challenge fee on the first funded payout.

faqs.question: How does the Goat Funded Trader scaling plan work?
faqs.answer: The scaling plan has four levels based on time funded and successful payouts: Level 1 (2 months, 4 payouts) adds 15% capital and a 90% split; Level 2 (4 months, 6 payouts) adds 30% and unlocks weekly payouts; Level 3 (5 months, 10 payouts) adds 40%, raises the split to 92%, and adds a monthly salary; Level 4, the GOAT tier (6 months, 15 payouts), adds 50% capital and a 95% split. All increases are calculated on the original account size, even after merges.

seo.metaDescription: Goat Funded Trader's 4-level scaling plan raises capital 15% to 50% and the split up to 95% as you hit funded milestones.
